title: Logos / Landscape lockup
slide_intent: Pair name and mascot where recognition is uncertain because either cue can help viewers identify the brand.
strategic_value: A fixed Duo-and-wordmark arrangement can strengthen Duolingo’s presence in third-party spaces.
demonstration: The landscape lockup is accompanied by guidance for press releases, conferences and placements managed by other companies.
practical_value: Choose the fixed landscape lockup when supplying a logo to a third party.

content_islands.name: Landscape specimen
content_islands.spec: Show Duo beside the wordmark in the large left panel, with the download control in its lower-right corner.

content_islands.name: Third-party guidance
content_islands.spec: Place the heading, recognition rationale, use examples and two Duo guidance links at right.

reference_purposes.Intent: The source says Duo’s recognizability aids awareness in third-party applications.
reference_purposes.Application: The copy names press releases, conferences and spaces managed by other companies.

ingredient.name: Landscape lockup
ingredient.role: Combine mascot recognition with the brand name.
ingredient.application: Supply the fixed lockup for the described third-party uses.
ingredient.scope: Historical archived guidelines. Applies to the historical landscape combination, not a direction to assemble arbitrary mascot poses.
